videoDetails.shortDescription:
With Flight number 14 SpaceX just showed the world why their Starship is the most important rocket ever made. And they proved it with not one, or two, but three historic accomplishments all on a single mission.

The Space Race is dedicated to the exploration of outer space and humanity's mission to explore the universe.
